name: project-horizon
description: System-Wide Multimodal Desktop & GUI Agent for Windows

scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n "FE,AGENT,PERCEPT" -c "cyan,blue,magenta" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:agent" "npm run dev:perception"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -k -n "FE,ELECTRON" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev:frontend" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run build:electron && electron ."
scripts.build:all: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:agent && npm run build:electron
scripts.test:desktop:hotkeys: npm run build:electron && node --test tests/hotkeys.cjs tests/rate-limit.cjs
scripts.test:all: npm run test:frontend && npm run test:agent && npm run test:desktop:commands && npm run test:desktop:hotkeys && npm run test:perception
scripts.test:capture: electron scripts/verify_real_desktop_pixels.js && electron scripts/benchmark_capture_latency.js && electron scripts/verify_multimonitor.js
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:electron
scripts.package:dir: npm run build:desktop && npm run prepare:installer && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build:desktop && npm run prepare:installer && electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.security-check: npm audit && npm audit --prefix frontend && npm audit --prefix backend/agent-service
